hooks.commandWindows: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "& { $p=(Get-Location).Path; while ($p) { $f=Join-Path $p '.codex/usage-hook.ps1'; if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $f){ & $f; exit $LASTEXITCODE }; $parent=Split-Path -Parent $p; if($parent -eq $p){ break }; $p=$parent }; Write-Output '{}' }"
